Cinema Encyclopedia on Instagram: "Leonardo DiCaprio winning his first Oscar for “The Revenant” after being nominated 5 times before, has to be one of the pinnacle moments for modern day cinema 🤌

#DidYouKnow according to Tom Hardy, Leonardo DiCaprio bet that Hardy would get nominated for an Oscar for his role in this film, whereas Hardy thought otherwise. The wager was that the loser would be forced to get a tattoo of the winner’s choice. It turned out that DiCaprio was right and the choice of tattoo was a hand scribed, “Leo knows all” by DiCaprio."
content.text: Leonardo DiCaprio winning his first Oscar for “The Revenant” after being nominated 5 times before, has to be one of the pinnacle moments for modern day cinema 🤌#DidYouKnow according to Tom Hardy, Leonardo DiCaprio bet that Hardy would get nominated for an Oscar for his role in this film, whereas Hardy thought otherwise. The wager was that the loser would be forced to get a tattoo of the winner’s choice. It turned out that DiCaprio was right and the choice of tattoo was a hand scribed, “Leo knows all” by DiCaprio.Mereceu por este e por tantos outros personagens que interpretou.Saw The Revenant in theaters 3 times. I’ve seen approximately 50 times since then, one of the best movies ever. Well deserved, and tom hardy was robbed!One of my old phones is buried in the attic somewhere… with a recording from this night. Everyone’s live reaction to Leo finally getting his Oscar that he should have received years before… just pure joy and excitement. Fast forward 10 years and these award shows have lost all meaningI’ll never forget. We were in mammoth and leaving the day of the Oscars. I was so nervous I was not going to make it back home on time to see this moment. Walked into the door a few minutes before this moment and cried when they called his name 😂 I have the video and everything.Imagine winning and Oscar and “Sweet Caroline is your walk up song.”And then he talked about not taking the planet for granted 😂
